title: Human Handoff Settings in Quickchat AI: Quick Reference
summary: Find Quickchat AI's Human Handoff settings: rules, working hours, messages, AI summaries, topic routing and email notifications.
body_markdown:
Configure **Human Handoff** in **Actions & MCPs > Human Handoff > Edit Action** . The settings control when the AI offers or initiates a transfer, what the visitor hears, and how your team receives the conversation.


This page is a short settings reference. For a complete example with copyable rules, a delivered human reply, handback and after-hours checks, follow[Chatbot Human Handoff: Build and Test the Whole Workflow](https://quickchat.ai/post/chatbot-human-handoff-workflow) .


## Where are the Human Handoff settings?


1. Open the intended AI Agent in the Quickchat AI dashboard.
2. Select **Actions & MCPs** in the left sidebar.
3. Find the **Human Handoff** card and turn its switch on.
4. Select **Edit Action** , make your changes and select **Save** .


The editor’s section menu lets you jump between messages, availability, rules, summaries, routing and notifications.


## What does each setting control?


Setting What to configure


**Question** Preferred wording when the AI asks whether the visitor wants a person to continue.


**Confirmation** Preferred wording for the transfer confirmation. The AI can generate its own confirmation when a handoff rule matches.


**Human Agents’ availability** Turn on the schedule restriction when transfers should depend on staffed hours.


**Your time zone** The time zone used for the schedule.


**Working hours** Working days and start/end times. Use **Add date** to add another schedule row.


**Message outside working hours** Explain when the team is available and give a next step your business actually supports.


**Handoff Rules** Enable relevant built-in rules and add descriptions of situations that need a person.


**AI summary** Generate a conversation summary so the teammate can review the context before replying.


**Topic-based routing** Enable teammate profiles and describe the conversations each should handle.


**Email notifications** Specify the monitored addresses that should receive handoff notifications.


For more detail on each control, see the[Human Handoff documentation](https://docs.quickchat.ai/ai-agent/actions/human-handoff/) .


## How do you add a handoff rule?


In **Handoff Rules** , use the **+** control to add a row. Fill **Rule Name** and **Description** , turn **State** on, and select **Save** . Review the built-in rules’ switches at the same time.


Describe a business situation the AI can recognize. For example, a refund rule can distinguish “What is the returns policy?” from “Can your team approve an exception to the returns policy?” Test both messages after saving; a plain-language rule requires evaluation against actual conversations.


## How should availability and routing be used?


A staffed-hours schedule and a routing profile serve different purposes. The schedule limits when the standard handoff can proceed. Routing can select a teammate whose profile matches the conversation; otherwise the conversation can remain **Unassigned** . Assignment does not prove that a teammate is online or will reply immediately.


An outside-hours response does not itself create a queued handoff or callback. Keep its wording consistent with the service your team provides. Configure notification recipients separately from routing profiles.


## Where does the team take over?


Open **Inbox** and inspect the conversation’s assignee. Use **Open > Unassigned** for conversations waiting in the shared queue. A teammate can select **Assign to me** , read the history and summary, and reply through the conversation composer.


Assigning the conversation back to **AI Agent** allows an AI reply to the next visitor message. The[Inbox guide](https://docs.quickchat.ai/conversations/inbox/#reassigning-a-conversation) explains these controls. Verify the full visitor conversation after changing settings, including the human reply and the next turn after reassignment.
